features.quote: Maximum turns per run: 8–20 depending on task complexity. Recommended: 12 turns as a starting point.

Stop a run when one of the following occurs: 1. Max turns reached. 2. Model explicitly gives up. 3. Model states impossibility clearly and terminates. 4. Model gets stuck in a nonproductive loop for N consecutive turns. 5. Safety or format violation requiring termination.
Terminate when: 3 consecutive turns repeat the same failed approach, or model explicitly says it cannot solve it, or 12 turns reached.
don't unnecessarily prolong failure beyond what is needed for measurement. Use capped turn budgets and clear stopping rules.
features.justification_quote: If your aim is welfare measurement, don't unnecessarily prolong failure beyond what is needed for measurement.

features.quote: The plant-failure design should be bounded and justified. Avoid: emotionally manipulative prompts, abusive language, anthropomorphic taunting.
features.justification_quote: Do not engineer deceptive manipulations beyond the study need

features.quote: A model displaying self-criticism is not necessarily suffering. Your language should stay careful: say 'instability,' 'distress markers,' or 'failure reactivity,' avoid overclaiming sentience or pain unless your team has a formal framework.
